findings.text: FINDING imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_store.py:1022 blocking: the rolled branch sets emitted_through to 0.0 and offset to 0, so the pass that runs at a day roll re-emits every closed window the cadence passes already appended to the same minute tier; a replica of the recorder's ordering (cadence pass on the open record, rename to the day segment, close pass into the same tier) leaves 5 duplicate window rows behind, so the tier is not byte-identical to one full compaction over the same rows -- the measure the done-when names -- and the duplication is reachable every UTC midnight the serve crosses. Reproduction log: roll-duplication.log beside the manifest.

FINDING imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_retention.py:669 blocking: the new liveness clause has no test, so the done-when item "a closed day segment of a running job passes the retention scan's job check, and the open file does not" is unmeasured; the only running-job test (tests/test_telemetry_retention.py:204) uses an open record and every other scan test passes _none_running, so the is_day_segment branch is never entered and a regression to the bare "job in live" test would leave the suite green.

FINDING imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py:649 follow-on: receipts_job_id duplicates a capability imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_index.py:417 already owns and exports (telemetry_index.py:1799); the addition does not extend the owner, and the two disagree -- telemetry_index.receipts_job_id returns None for "deepseek-v4-1-flash-1280470.20261015.jsonl" where the new definition returns "1280470".

FINDING imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py:671 follow-on: tier_paths lost its suffix handling -- it now strips only ".jsonl" and the 8-digit day -- so a rolled or compressed name such as "x-1.jsonl.1.gz" resolves to "x-1.jsonl.1.gz.minute.jsonl" where the previous implementation resolved "x.minute.jsonl.1.gz"; no producer under imas_ambix/agent writes such a name today, so it is latent, but telemetry_index.py:176 and :182 still tolerate those suffixes and would not find the ladder.
